members.name: Elinor Faulkner
members.bio: Elinor leads the RMS team, bringing together regulatory consultants and registered migration agents to deliver registration, Medicare and visa outcomes for employers and practitioners alike.

members.name: Alexandra Graham
members.bio: A MARA-registered migration agent, Alexandra guides practitioners and employers through visa nominations and applications — managing the immigration detail from first assessment through to arrival.

members.name: Ebony Kouka
members.bio: Ebony is RMS’s regulatory expert for General Practitioners, guiding GPs through the complex AHPRA, RACGP and Medicare requirements. Before joining in 2019 she was an Immigration Officer in New Zealand, and brings honesty, empathy and genuine care to every case.

members.name: Lisa Greaves
members.bio:
Lisa has held a variety of roles during her time at RMS and, after moving overseas in 2017, rejoined the team in 2023 as a Regulatory Coordinator.

Originally from Ireland, she draws on her own experience of the migration journey to provide exceptional support to international medical graduates making the move to Australia.
